editionLabel: Osprey Games original English base game
firstPlayerRule: Choose a starting player; the rulebook suggests the person who set up the map. That player places the first information cube and takes the first turn, with play continuing clockwise.
clarifications: The map setter is a suggestion, not a required starting-player criterion.
During initial sharing, each player places a cube in turn order, starting with the chosen player and continuing clockwise until everyone has placed two cubes.
The starting player then takes the first normal turn.
